title: Research: prove the unrestricted three-query reader floor
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed PR3370 matrix, actual complete-plane reader tariff
- PR3407: rational three-query basis, binary seed inside the two groups
+ any three independent queries over any field, arbitrary values and support
 sharp pair floor m_A + m_B; disjoint replacements keep total tariff 224
```

The new proof reassigns the seed separately at each port after an equality-preserving grid map. This produces integral factors whose query and reader supports are contained in the originals. It closes the nonbinary/global-support continuation without changing the fitting matrix or extending a physical supplier. Only `research/p112-unrestricted-three-query/` is added.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3407 explicitly leaves nonbinary seeds open. **After:** a self-contained all-field proof handles every independent three-query realization of a literal pair, including seeds outside both groups.
- All 13 equality patterns, 40 exact rational operators and 24 support-dominated integral replacements pass. A separate implementation checks all 12,456 affine triangles over F2/F3/F5 and all 50,176 entries of the literal expanded identity.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized CPython 3.15 replay, six behavioral groups with five actual CLI corruptions, Ruff diagnostics and formatting pass. Actual committed bytes, declared canonical source history and a read-only Git-free committed export also pass.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-unrestricted-three-query
```

The metadata-only follow-ups preserve every proof, code and mathematical evidence byte from `9c76702cb`. Final-head source history and export transport pass; the existing mathematical replay receipts bind those identical scientific files.

Source pins and reproduction limits are in `SOURCES.json`, `PROOF.md` and `VALIDATION.md`. Credit Tekalign/PR3370, PR3407, PR3398, PR3383, PR3345, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained P112/E8 lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

This is an author-checked scoped obstruction, with no new kappa or selected-frontier change. Dependent/longer query lists, changed matrices, native coefficient execution, restoration, hosting and supplier/outer transfer remain open. Human review, formal proof-kernel acceptance, hosted CI and the selected cold replay are not claimed.
